   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "0911cd61",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "# LQR tracking: following a reference trajectory\n",
    "\n",
    "This notebook uses the double integrator from the\n",
    "[previous example](lqr_integrator.ipynb), but now the state should follow a time-varying target\n",
    "$x^\\star_t$ rather than return to the origin:\n",
    "\n",
    "$$\n",
    "J = \\tfrac12 (x_T - x^\\star_T)^\\top Q_f (x_T - x^\\star_T)\n",
    "  + \\sum_{t=0}^{T-1} \\tfrac12 (x_t - x^\\star_t)^\\top Q (x_t - x^\\star_t) + \\tfrac12 u_t^\\top R u_t .\n",
    "$$\n",
    "\n",
    "**From tracking to standard LQR.** Expanding the square gives\n",
    "$\\tfrac12 x^\\top Q x - (Q x^\\star)^\\top x + \\text{const}$. Tracking is therefore a standard LQR\n",
    "with linear cost terms\n",
    "\n",
    "$$\n",
    "q_t = -Q x^\\star_t, \\qquad q_f = -Q_f x^\\star_T .\n",
    "$$\n",
    "\n",
    "The constant does not change the optimal trajectory."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 1,
   "id": "6d303f55",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-14T22:41:20.312700Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-14T22:41:20.312151Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-14T22:41:20.972891Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-14T22:41:20.972002Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "from functools import partial\n",
    "\n",
    "import jax\n",
    "import jax.numpy as jnp\n",
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "\n",
    "from diffilqrax.lqr import solve_lqr, kkt\n",
    "from diffilqrax.typs import LQR, LQRParams, ModelDims\n",
    "\n",
    "jax.config.update(\"jax_enable_x64\", True)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "41aa7b63",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Target trajectory\n",
    "\n",
    "The position should follow a sine wave, and the velocity should follow the matching cosine (the\n",
    "time derivative of the position target). With these targets the reference is dynamically\n",
    "consistent, so the controller can track it closely."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "id": "4f48e2bd",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-14T22:41:20.976649Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-14T22:41:20.976335Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-14T22:41:21.216951Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-14T22:41:21.216356Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "dims = ModelDims(n=2, m=1, horizon=200, dt=0.05)\n",
    "T, n, m = dims.horizon, dims.n, dims.m\n",
    "time = jnp.arange(T + 1) * dims.dt\n",
    "\n",
    "omega = 2 * jnp.pi / 5.0  # period of 5 time units\n",
    "x_target = jnp.stack([jnp.sin(omega * time), omega * jnp.cos(omega * time)], axis=-1)  # (T+1, n)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "fcfa74c5",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Setting up the LQR\n",
    "\n",
    "Only the linear terms differ from the regulation problem. The position error is weighted more than\n",
    "the velocity error, and the terminal weight $Q_f$ is set equal to $Q$."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 3,
   "id": "e76aefbc",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-14T22:41:21.220299Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-14T22:41:21.220108Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-14T22:41:22.316402Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-14T22:41:22.315805Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "A = jnp.array([[1.0, dims.dt], [0.0, 1.0]])\n",
    "B = jnp.array([[0.5 * dims.dt**2], [dims.dt]])\n",
    "Q = jnp.diag(jnp.array([100.0, 1.0]))\n",
    "R = 0.1 * jnp.eye(m)\n",
    "Qf = Q\n",
    "\n",
    "span_mat = partial(jnp.tile, reps=(T, 1, 1))\n",
    "span_vec = partial(jnp.tile, reps=(T, 1))\n",
    "\n",
    "lqr = LQR(\n",
    "    A=span_mat(A),\n",
    "    B=span_mat(B),\n",
    "    a=span_vec(jnp.zeros(n)),\n",
    "    Q=span_mat(Q),\n",
    "    q=-(x_target[:-1] @ Q.T),  # q_t = -Q x*_t\n",
    "    R=span_mat(R),\n",
    "    r=span_vec(jnp.zeros(m)),\n",
    "    S=span_mat(jnp.zeros((n, m))),\n",
    "    Qf=Qf,\n",
    "    qf=-Qf @ x_target[-1],     # q_f = -Q_f x*_T\n",
    ")\n",
    "params = LQRParams(x0=jnp.array([-1.0, 0.0]), lqr=lqr)  # start away from the target"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 4,
   "id": "966e36f0",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-14T22:41:22.319998Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-14T22:41:22.319781Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-14T22:41:23.528662Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-14T22:41:23.527987Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "KKT residuals: 8.03e-13\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "Xs, Us, lambdas = solve_lqr(params)\n",
    "dLdX, dLdU, dLdLambda = kkt(params, Xs, Us, lambdas)\n",
    "print(f\"KKT residuals: {max(jnp.abs(r).max() for r in (dLdX, dLdU, dLdLambda)):.2e}\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 5,
   "id": "cf887e1b",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-14T22:41:23.532017Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-14T22:41:23.531732Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-14T22:41:24.979931Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-14T22:41:24.979271Z"
    },

     "thumbnail"
    ]
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 700x550 with 3 Axes>"
      ]

     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "fig, axes = plt.subplots(3, 1, figsize=(7, 5.5), sharex=True, layout=\"constrained\")\n",
    "for i, label in enumerate([\"position\", \"velocity\"]):\n",
    "    axes[i].plot(time, x_target[:, i], \"k:\", label=\"target\")\n",
    "    axes[i].plot(time, Xs[:, i], c=f\"C{i}\", label=\"LQR\")\n",
    "    axes[i].set_ylabel(label)\n",
    "axes[0].legend(loc=\"upper right\")\n",
    "axes[2].plot(time[:-1], Us, c=\"C2\")\n",
    "axes[2].set(ylabel=\"input\", xlabel=\"time\");"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "ecf302f3",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "The controller first closes the gap from $x_0 = (-1, 0)$ to the target. After that, the input is\n",
    "the acceleration the reference needs, $-\\omega^2 \\sin(\\omega t)$.\n",
    "\n",
    "## How to adapt\n",
    "\n",
    "- **Any reference:** set `x_target` to any array of shape `(T+1, n)`. If the reference is not\n",
    "  dynamically feasible, the controller trades tracking error against effort through `Q` and `R`.\n",
    "- **Tracking only part of the state:** put zeros in the diagonal of `Q` for components you do not\n",
    "  care about. Their entries in `q` then vanish automatically.\n",
    "- **Input references:** to track a nominal input $u^\\star_t$, set `r = -(u_target @ R.T)` in the\n",
    "  same way.\n",
    "- **Time-varying weights:** build `Q` with shape `(T, n, n)`. For example, weight later times more\n",
    "  heavily to allow a transient at the start."
   ]
  }
 ],
